title: Spanakopita Stuffed Leeks
description: A unique twist on traditional spanakopita, with tender leeks wrapped around a flavorful spinach and feta filling.

ingredients.name: leek
ingredients.notes: white and light green parts only

instructions: Trim the leeks, leaving the root end intact. Cut off the dark green tops and set aside.
Brush the leeks with Greek yogurt, then season with salt and black pepper.
Cut a horizontal slit in each leek, creating a pocket to fill.
Spoon the spanakopita mixture into each leek pocket.
Top each leek with crumbled feta cheese and a sprinkle of minced garlic.
Place the leeks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the leeks are tender and the filling is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with the reserved dark green leek tops.
